_meta.description: Maldros Visual Design System (C-031) exposed as a continuously-queryable CDI domain. Every agent producing or modifying a visual artifact must query this domain before emitting output. A Capability Bundle that does not record a design_system query in its lineage trace, when the task produces visual output, is a Diagnostic Agent L1 failure.
_meta.update_policy: Updated via cdi_update.py only. Direct writes forbidden. Hex-token edits require simultaneous updates to lib/design_tokens.py and lib/design_tokens.css under the Maldros Visual Artifacts cluster rule.
_meta.governance: D-6 (no deviation from sources); changes are operator-approved per D-7 and logged as C-NNN entries

communication_pattern._role: Every artifact follows this reading order at document level, section level, and individual visualization level.

descriptions.FINDING: Lead with the primary conclusion. Narrative titles, never descriptive.
descriptions.IMPACT: Immediately follow the finding with its significance — financial exposure, operational priority, strategic risk.
descriptions.EVIDENCE: Supporting charts, KPIs, data breakdowns. Validates the finding — does not introduce it.
descriptions.RECOMMENDATION: Close every section with actions, decisions, or next steps.

color_system._role: Four data-meaning colors carry semantic meaning. Canvas/ink values are infrastructure (substrate/text) and are not counted as data colors.

PRIMARY.name: Forest
PRIMARY.apply_to: authority, structure, baseline, primary chart series, section headers

SECONDARY.name: Amber
SECONDARY.apply_to: anomalies, risks, key findings, focal subject, call-out borders

TERTIARY.name: Parchment
TERTIARY.apply_to: KPI surfaces, insight panel backgrounds, supporting content surfaces

INK.role: primary body text; never pure black

INK_MUTED.role: muted text, axis labels, footnote sources

prohibitions: Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) or pure black (#000000).
Never introduce a fifth data-meaning color without documented justification.
Never use color decoratively — every applied color must carry semantic meaning.
Never add gradients, drop shadows on data elements, or decorative fills.

Tier_1_Primary_Finding.use_for: the single most important statement; one per section

Tier_2_KPI_Value.use_for: performance indicators, financial figures; always paired with Tier 3 label + Tier 4 context

Tier_3_Section_Title.use_for: section headers, chart titles (narrative, never descriptive), KPI labels

Tier_4_Annotation.use_for: axis labels, footnotes, methodology notes, source references

L1_Executive_Summary.content: primary finding, major changes, critical observations, most important KPIs

L3_Charts_Evidence.content: visualizations validating L1/L2 — not introducing new conclusions

L4_Interpretation_Recs.position: end of each section + end of document

stakeholder_calibration.Executives: Emphasize L1; minimize chart complexity; recommendations state ROI or strategic priority.
stakeholder_calibration.Managers: Emphasize L2 + L4; include resource allocation and scale indicators.
stakeholder_calibration.Analysts: Emphasize L3; include methodology notes, confidence indicators, statistical validity.
stakeholder_calibration.Operators: Emphasize L4; convert recommendations to discrete executable actions.

query_log._role: Agents querying this domain are logged here. Agents producing visual output without a query are flagged for L1 review.

non_activation_policy.trigger: When a task produces any visual artifact (HTML, PNG, dashboard, presentation slide, etc.)
non_activation_policy.required_action: Orchestrator (or downstream agent) MUST query this domain and record the query_id in the Capability Bundle lineage trace.
non_activation_policy.non_compliance_consequence: Diagnostic Agent L1 failure; output blocked at Storyteller pre-submission gate (C7) when implemented in full (Phase 2).
